property_summary: For any two successive calls SetMinSum(a) then SetMinSum(b) on a fresh-but-not-yet-initialized contract, the reference sets MinSum equal to b after the second call (it overwrites), whereas the mutant accumulates so MinSum becomes a+b (thus differing for many fuzzed a,b).
change_summary: Make SetMinSum add to the existing MinSum instead of overwriting it (accumulative update).
